title: Anime Cards
description: Makes the anime style cards draw properly.

settings.title: Hide level badge
settings.help: The level/rank number the duel draws over the monsters in your hand (and the badge on other card views). 0 = show it (vanilla), 1 = hide it in the hand, 2 = hide it everywhere. The anime frames already show the stars on the card. Restart the game after changing it.

settings.title: Use large atk def font
settings.help: Draw ATK/DEF with the game's larger (32 px) number font, so the scaled numbers stay sharper.

settings.title: Custom atk x
settings.help: ATK number: centre X on the 400 x 580 card face (the left box).

settings.title: Custom atk y
settings.help: ATK number: centre Y on the card face.

settings.title: Custom def x
settings.help: DEF number (Link rating on Link monsters): centre X (the right box).

settings.title: Custom def y
settings.help: DEF number: centre Y on the card face.

settings.title: Atk text scale
settings.help: Size of the ATK text.

settings.title: Def text scale
settings.help: Size of the DEF text.

settings.title: Attribute x
settings.help: Attribute icon: centre X, in the frame's circle (monster frames).

settings.title: Attribute y
settings.help: Attribute icon: centre Y.

settings.title: Link attribute x
settings.help: Attribute icon on the Link frame: centre X.

settings.title: Link attribute y
settings.help: Attribute icon on the Link frame: centre Y.

settings.title: Attribute size
settings.help: Attribute icon size in pixels on the card face (48 covers the frame's 45 px circle).

settings.title: Stars x
settings.help: Level/rank stars: the row is centred on this X.

settings.title: Stars y
settings.help: Level/rank stars: centre Y (the band between the art and the ATK/DEF boxes). Below 0 keeps the game's own height.

settings.title: Stars max width
settings.help: Widest the star row may be before it's shrunk to fit (keeps it clear of the attribute circle).

settings.title: Card art scale
settings.help: Size of the card art.

settings.title: Card art offset x
settings.help: Card art horizontal offset.

settings.title: Card art offset y
settings.help: Card art vertical offset.

settings.title: Custom ST icon x
settings.help: Spell/Trap icon X position.

settings.title: Custom ST icon y
settings.help: Spell/Trap icon Y position.
